name: vscode-clone
description: Portfolio-quality VS Code clone built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES Modules). Zero dependencies.
author: Mehdi Khorshidi far <mehdi.khorshidi9339@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --target ES2020 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --noImplicitAny --strictNullChecks --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --noImplicitReturns --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --skipLibCheck --lib ES2020,DOM src/app.js
